_compactTableRatchet: The compact one-line table is FROZEN (product-owner decision, 2026-08-30): no new row may join
that format, and the existing ones convert to detailed rows opportunistically. This number may
only ever DECREASE — check:debt-status fails if the table grows, and fails if this number is
above the measured count, so a conversion must be recorded here in the same commit.
It is 42, not the 66 the spec stated. 66 was 42 compact rows PLUS the 24 rows of the
Closed-numbers ledger, which is a permanent record that only ever grows — so a ratchet of 66
would have permitted 24 new compact rows before it ever fired. Measured 2026-08-30.
